subject: MdeModulePkg: Update performance measurements to use new perf macros
reasons: While the commit is in the same PERF_FUNCTION_* migration series as 11af818b3e (SecurityPkg), the specific changes here are mixed: adds PERF_FUNCTION_END() at early-return paths (Dispatcher.c) and adds PERF_CROSSMODULE_END/BEGIN pairs (BmBoot.c) — not a uniform PERF_START_EX/PERF_END_EX replacement

The PERF_CROSSMODULE_END/BEGIN insertions at specific semantic points (before legacy boot return, after BmEndOfBdsPerfCode) require case-by-case reasoning about the control flow, not a structural pattern match
The Dispatcher.c changes insert PERF_FUNCTION_END() at early return sites which is context-dependent; no clean before/after SmPL rule can express this insertion
